controls.procedure: Run the two-connection writer-versus-completion integration case and hold the writer until completion has attempted to acquire the lifecycle row lock.
controls.expected: Completion waits for the draft write, reads the committed value, and no ordinary mutation succeeds after COMPLETED.
controls.observed: The writer completed first, completion observed the committed required value, and the next ordinary value update was rejected after COMPLETED.

controls.procedure: Complete an assessment, then attempt ordinary header, measurement and observation mutations and reread the persisted assessment.
controls.expected: Every ordinary mutation is rejected and all completed historical fields retain their prior values.
controls.observed: Header update, measurement update and observation delete were rejected; persisted notes, value and observation remained at the completed values.

controls.procedure: Create two deliberately distinct contractId tenants, try tenant B segment injection into tenant A assessment, then read tenant A assessment through tenant B scope.
controls.expected: Cross-tenant segment mutation is rejected, cross-tenant assessment lookup returns no record, and no foreign segment value is persisted.
controls.observed: The segment injection returned INVALID_SEGMENT, the other-tenant assessment read returned null, and foreign persisted row count stayed zero.
